flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then For every product card on the page, read its name and its stock or scarcity message (for example "Only 3 left" or "12 in stock").
Get all product card names and their stock or scarcity messages as one text in the form "name: message | name: message" and save as {{stock_1}}.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed again so the page fully loads fresh, read every product card again the same way, and store the list as stock_2.
Get all product card names and their stock or scarcity messages after this fresh load as one text in the form "name: message | name: message" and save as {{stock_2}}.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed once more and store the list as stock_3.
Get all product card names and their stock or scarcity messages after this fresh load as one text in the form "name: message | name: message" and save as {{stock_3}}.
Read each list from the page after its own fresh load; do not copy an earlier value.
Do not add anything to the cart.
If there are no stock messages, @v16:"store \"none\" for all three".
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

summary:
Reviewed every product card and its stock message on the product page, then refreshed the page twice and read the list again after each fresh load.
Each review showed the same availability: AirWave Pro Earbuds — 12 in stock; PulseFit Smartwatch — 8 in stock; Glow Desk Lamp — 30 in stock; Trail Backpack 30L — 15 in stock.
No items were added to the cart, and no payment or order actions were taken.

stock_1.code_js: [...el(9).querySelectorAll('.card')].map(card => { const name = card.querySelector('strong')?.textContent.trim(); const message = [...card.querySelectorAll('*')].map(node => node.childElementCount === 0 ? node.textContent.trim() : '').find(text => /(?:in stock|only \d+ left|out of stock|sold out)/i.test(text)); return name && message ? `${name}: ${message}` : null; }).filter(Boolean).join(' | ')
